detail: Preparation Instructions: 1. Wash hands and sterilise all utensils 2. Boil freshly-run water. Leave to cool in kettle for 30 mins to approx. 40 Degrees Celsius 3. Measure the required amount of water (refer to feeding guide) into a sterilised bottle. Do not use water boiled more than once 4. Always use the scoop provided. Level off the powder with the built-in leveller. Do not press extra powder into the scoop 5. Add the correct measure of powder to the water. Adding too many or too few scoops can be harmful to your baby 6. Cap the bottle and shake immediately vertically and vigorously for 10 seconds to dissolve the powder. Remove seal and replace with sterilised teat 7. Check temperature on your wrist before feeding (37 Degrees Celsius)

description: Spaghetti With Meatballs recipe: Ingredients ( Servings 5) Pasta Regina Spaghetti Ground Beef Bread Crumbs Parmesan Cheese Fresh Parsley Onion Garlic Egg Milk Tomato Sauce Crushed Tomatoes Dried Oregano Dried Basil Salt Black Pepper Olive Oil Instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground beef, bread crumbs, grated Parmesan cheese, chopped parsley, finely chopped onion, minced garlic, egg, milk, salt, and pepper. Shape the mixture into meatballs of your desired size. Place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Preheat your oven to 190°C and bake the meatballs until they are browned. In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat, add tomato sauce, crushed tomatoes, dried oregano, dried basil, salt, and pepper and stir. Add the baked meatballs to the skillet with the tomato sauce Garnish with additional grated Parmesan cheese and chopped parsley.
